svg.title: Call stack of VectorStorePipeline.run on main versus split/8-review-fixes
svg.desc: On main, run calls apply(plan()): _plan_from_paths hashes on the event loop and gathers every source, _process compares source_hash catching BaseException, chunk_document fakes source_hash from content_hash; apply then embeds all chunks, deletes all stale points, and upserts with a plain batched loop. On head, run calls engine.run on a resolved SyncPlanInput: build_current_map hashes in threads, SyncEngine.run consumes a back-pressured stream, _evaluate compares tokens catching Exception only, DocumentPipeline.run composes ingest and chunk, and _write_change embeds one source then _write_source picks replace_source, which writes blanked points, deletes stale ones, and stamps hashes.

g.text: _plan_from_paths — hash on the loop, gather every source
apply — embed all, delete all stale, then upsert all
build_current_map — hash in threads; unreadable → errors
SyncEngine.run — consume the stream, write per source
